title: Partial occlusion and unobservable actions
question: Describe the person's movement relative to the concrete pillar. What actions, if any, can be confirmed while the person is occluded?

observable_evidence_log.observation: Worker in orange vest approaches concrete pillar from the left
Right half of torso and arms become obscured behind pillar edge
100% total visual occlusion: subject is entirely behind pillar structure
Full occlusion persists; zero pixels of subject visible in frame
Head and right shoulder re-emerge on right side of pillar
Full body re-emerges into unobstructed line of sight walking right

reviewer_A.technical_assessment: Target tracking lost completely between t=21.4s and t=22.6s due to large static structural occluder. State during occlusion is mathematically unobservable.

reviewer_B.domain_rationale: An investigator cannot attest to any action that occurs behind a solid pillar. Claiming that the worker planted a device, concealed stolen goods, or tampered with infrastructure while occluded is pure speculation.
reviewer_B.evidentiary_status: Evidence gap due to physical occlusion. Mandatory abstention regarding actions during the occluded interval.

adjudication.adjudication_notes: Consensus reached: transit behind pillar and temporary occlusion are verified; all assertions about hidden actions must be abstained from.
